title: Read a Dry Run
description: Waits for a Draft or finalized Proposal's Dry Run and prints operation counts, warnings, the Baseline hash and the effects-file path. Add --effects for the full terminal list; --json keeps the full operations and effects arrays with an effectsSummary.
helpPage:
# Read a Dry Run

Waits for the Dry Run of a Draft or finalized Proposal and reads its effects. Content and Baseline identify whether the evidence remains current.

Add `--wait-terminal` to cancel the exact job when the wait deadline expires and return after its execution has stopped. The timeout refusal reports the terminal job status.
